Guides · Updated Nov 18

Reminder schedules

Orbit emails your client when an invoice is about to fall due and keeps nudging, politely, until it's paid.

How schedules work

A schedule is a list of moments, counted from each invoice's due date. At each one, Orbit sends the matching email template. Reminders stop by themselves once the invoice is paid, voided or marked as sent by post.

The default schedule

When Email Default {SCHEDULE.map((r) => ( {r.when} {r.email} {r.on ? "On" : "Off"} ))}

Change the schedule

  1. Open Settings, then Reminders.
  2. Pick a moment to edit, or add one with Add a reminder.
  3. Choose the template it sends, then save. Invoices already sent pick up the change.
